mentions.name: label-tiles
mentions.description: This tool builds labeled object detection training datasets from large-scale satellite and aerial imagery collections. It leverages the standard web map tile server API to label and fine-tune ML models on map imagery, testing ML applications of tile-serving infrastructure built for map visualization.
